title: UI preferences (per user)
description: v0 WEB-UIPREF. Stored in web.ui_preferences (writer control-plane-api). `job_view` picks the job page: `simple` (plain-language progress, the default when unset) or `detailed` (graph and activity feed). `version` is the optimistic-concurrency token: PUT with a stale version (body or If-Match) is refused with 412.
